notes.title: 0.10.0 - Camera Controls and Environements
notes.content: [h1]Update 0.10.0[/h1][p] [/p][h2]Changes :[/h2][olist][*][p]The camera can now be freely moved around by dragging the background with the mouse / using the "camera mode" with the controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Middle mouse button can now recenter the camera around the puzzle pieces. [/p][/*][*][p]New floating text tutorials to explain these new controls[/p][/*][*][p]Some levels move the camera to new areas with darker / lighter moods that correspond better to their theme.[/p][/*][*][p]The mining theme's rocks' lights now gradually pulse from dark to bright[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual changes to the level select screen[/p][/*][/olist][p] [/p][h2]Fixed Bugs :[/h2][olist][*][p]Level 5 sometimes started with a missing piece[/p][/*][*][p]The player could clip through solid platforms when a piece was picked up and dropped very quickly[/p][/*][*][p]The player could enter the "ghost piece" overlay[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain changes could thread infinitely[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing ESC in certain menus would play the SFX twice[/p][/*][*][p]The mouse cursor was slightly offset[/p][/*][/olist][p] [/p][h2]Known, Unfixed Bugs :[/h2][olist][*][p]The player's speed can increase temporarily if they try to dig while in between a dirt block and a wall [/p][/*][*][p]Some player animations may play strangely when running into a wall[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzle pieces edge lights do not connect properly between them[/p][/*][/olist]

tags.feature: The camera can now be freely moved around by dragging the background with the mouse / using the "camera mode" with the controller.
Middle mouse button can now recenter the camera around the puzzle pieces.
New floating text tutorials to explain these new controls

tags.bug: Level 5 sometimes started with a missing piece
The player could clip through solid platforms when a piece was picked up and dropped very quickly
The player could enter the "ghost piece" overlay

Pressing ESC in certain menus would play the SFX twice
The mouse cursor was slightly offset

tags.bug: Game used to crash when using a controller in the world select menu
It was possible to select the invisible ghost piece when playing with a controller
Changing to fullscreen using F11 didn't save it as a preference in the settings
The player could teleport to another piece if one was centered on top of them when they exitted their digging animation.

tags.feature: A feedback menu (accessible anywhere using F12) was added. Send your feedback, bugs, or even ideas using it !

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - Visuals and QOL
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.9.0[/h1]

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] You now need to press "up" to enter a door. This should prevent finishing a level by accident
[*] The Neon Polygons splash screen was remade in-engine
[*] Dimensional rifts are now distorted when in proximity of the player
[*] A visual feedback was added when hovering checkboxes
[*] Improved performances in levels containing a lot of puzzle pieces
[*] Puzzle pieces now change their appearance when connecting with another piece to match their layout
[/olist]

[h2]Fixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added missing tile in one of the levels
[*] Fixed a visual glitch with the pause button when dragging over it
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would sometimes enter a door automatically when close to it and dropping the piece
[*] Fixed a bug where flat sides would sometimes not connect properly
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed an impossible type of connection to happen
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would move weirdly in angled pieces
[*] Removed the initial click sound that played in levels where puzzle pieces start connected
[/olist]

[h2]Known, Unfixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The player's speed can increase temporarily if they try to dig while in between a dirt block and a wall
[*] Glowing dirt in the miner theme sometimes has its light flicker
[*] shadows inside the miner's theme do not always appear
[/olist]

Puzzle pieces now change their appearance when connecting with another piece to match their layout

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - Minor BugFixes
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.2.0[/h1]

[h2]Fixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] You can no longer zoom / unzoom during screen transitions
[*] You can no longer zoom / unzoom in the settings menu
[*] You can no longer drag pieces outside of the viewport
[*] Aligning two flat sides perfectly no longer connects them if they are not connected through other pieces
[*] The player will no longer disappear if a piece is picked up when they are standing exactly in the middle of the two pieces.
[*] Pieces will now prioritise snapping to the biggest connection group, instead of moving the already placed pieces towards it.
[*] Pieces now correctly lose their focus when the game is paused.
[/olist]

[h2]Known, Unfixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The player's speed can increase temporarily if they try to dig while in between a dirt block and a wall.
[*] Glowing dirt in the miner theme sometimes has its light flicker.
[/olist]
